business_summary: Newmark Group, Inc. operates as a commercial real estate advisor and service provider in the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia, rest of Europe, and other Americas. The company offers capital markets services consisting of investment sales, including placement and raising of equity; and commercial mortgage brokerage, such as government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) and federal housing administration (FHA) lending, as well as the placement of debt, loan sales, and structured finance on behalf of third parties. It also provides landlord or agency representation leasing; GSEs and FHA multifamily loan servicing, as well as limited loan servicing, special loan servicing, and asset management; management consulting, managed services, and fund accounting for investors; valuation and advisory services; property management and workspace solutions for owners; due diligence, consulting, and other advisory services; commercial real estate technology platform and capabilities; and business rates for property owners. In addition, the company offers tenant representation leasing; occupier solutions comprising project management, transaction management, lease administration, and facilities management, as well as corporate consulting services to real estate and supply chain optimization, workplace strategy, and occupancy strategy areas; workspace solutions for occupiers; and business rates for occupiers. It serves commercial real estate tenants, investors, owners, occupiers, and developers, lenders, small and medium size businesses, multi-national corporations, and institutional owners of real estate. The company was formerly known as Newmark Grubb Knight Frank Capital Group and changed its name to Newmark Group, Inc. in October 2017. Newmark Group, Inc. was founded in 1929 and is based in New York, New York. Newmark Group, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Cantor Fitzgerald, L.P.
business_summary_ko: Newmark Group, Inc.는 미국, 영국, 아시아, 기타 유럽 및 기타 아메리카 지역에서 상업용 부동산 자문 및 서비스 제공업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 회사는 자본 배치 및 자본 조달을 포함한 투자 판매로 구성된 자본 시장 서비스를 제공합니다. 정부 후원 기업(GSE) 및 연방 주택 관리(FHA) 대출과 같은 상업용 모기지 중개는 물론 제3자를 대신하여 부채 배치, 대출 판매 및 구조화 금융을 담당합니다. 또한 집주인이나 대리 임대 서비스도 제공합니다. GSE 및 FHA 다가구 대출 서비스, 제한 대출 서비스, 특별 대출 서비스 및 자산 관리 투자자를 위한 경영 컨설팅, 관리 서비스, 펀드 회계; 평가 및 자문 서비스; 소유자를 위한 자산 관리 및 작업 공간 솔루션; 실사, 컨설팅 및 기타 자문 서비스; 상업용 부동산 기술 플랫폼 및 기능; 부동산 소유자를 위한 사업 요율. 또한 회사는 임차인 대표 임대 서비스를 제공합니다. 프로젝트 관리, 거래 관리, 임대 관리, 시설 관리로 구성된 점유자 솔루션
